# Demure Mineral Makeup: Natural Coverage Made With Pure Crushed Minerals

Give your skin a natural finish with a mineral makeup formula that keeps ingredients simple. Demure Mineral Makeup offers lightweight, buildable coverage for everyday wear.

## Clean Formula for Sensitive Skin

Made with pure crushed minerals, this formula contains no chemicals, fillers, binders, fragrance, or common irritants such as talc, rice, or bismuth oxychloride. It is hypoallergenic and formulated for sensitive, oily, dry, and mature skin, so you can apply it without worrying about harsh additives.

## Coverage That Adapts to Your Routine

Apply a thin layer for sheer to light coverage, or build additional layers for medium to full coverage. The formula feels lightweight and water resistant. Choose from 11 foundation shades, or mix shades to create your own match. The Dark Warm shade suits deeper skin tones with golden or olive undertones.

## Radiant Results From a Little Product

Because the powder is highly pigmented, a small amount goes a long way. Use a light touch to achieve a radiant, flawless look that lets your skin breathe.

## Ethically Made in the USA

This makeup is cruelty free, not tested on animals, and made in the USA.

## Shop With Confidence

Your purchase is risk free. If you are not happy with your order, contact us within 30 days for a replacement or a refund.

Add Demure Mineral Makeup to your cart today and discover a natural finish you can build to suit your skin.
